title: arenaria muralis
intro: Arenaria muralis, commonly known as Snow Wort or Wall Carnation, is a low-growing, flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family. It is known for its small white flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and diuretic properties, which help to relieve muscle spasms, coughs, and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria muralis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
